gloss: daily rate; prorated by the day

definitions.gloss: daily rate; prorating by the day; per diem calculation
definitions.explanation: Dividing a total amount (typically rent, salary, or fees) by the number of days to calculate a daily rate. Used when charges need to be prorated for a partial period.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}は{日割|ひわ}りで{計算|けいさん}する。
examples.english: The rent is calculated on a daily basis.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}の{途中|とちゅう}で{入居|にゅうきょ}したので{日割|ひわ}り{家賃|やちん}になった。
examples.english: Since I moved in mid-month, the rent was prorated by the day.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}は{日割|ひわ}り{計算|けいさん}で{支払|しはら}われた。
examples.english: The salary was paid based on a daily prorated calculation.

notes: Composed of {日|ひ} (day) + {割|わ}り (division, rate). Common compounds: {日割|ひわ}り{家賃|やちん} (prorated rent), {日割|ひわ}り{計算|けいさん} (daily proration), {日割|ひわ}り{料金|りょうきん} (daily rate charge). Frequently encountered when moving into or out of an apartment mid-month, or when starting/ending a subscription partway through a billing period. Related: {月割|つきわ}り (monthly rate), {時間割|じかんわり} (timetable/schedule).
